critical_code_review_comments: ShopSignoffCard's 'action_taken' field is a <select> (Repaired / Tagged out of service / Parts ordered / No action needed), not a free-text input. The data-testid name 'signoff-action-{section}-{item}' is fine but consumers/testers should know to use page.select_option(), not page.fill(). Consider documenting this in the test_credentials.md or adding a 'placeholder' option.

ViewEquipmentInspection.jsx checks res?.status === 'fail' (lowercase) at line 220, while the public POST /api/equipment-inspections accepts arbitrary case in checklist[*][*].status. Backend stores whatever the client sent verbatim, so an inspection POSTed with status='FAIL' (uppercase) would NOT trigger the ShopSignoffCard render even though backend trends/open-items correctly count it. Recommend normalizing status to lowercase server-side at write time (or in the frontend View page check both cases) so future API consumers (e.g. mobile clients, integration tests) don't trip.

shop_token is stored in localStorage as 'masci.shop.token' — a 64-char HMAC of the shop password using ADMIN_HMAC_SECRET. Same pattern as admin token, fine. Note: there is NO server-side session/revocation mechanism — rotating SHOP_PASSWORD invalidates all tokens via HMAC mismatch, which is the intended behavior and is documented in test_credentials.md.

POST /api/admin/equipment-inspections/{id}/signoff and DELETE both use require_shop_or_admin — confirmed working with either token. Endpoint path includes '/admin/' but accepts shop token too — slightly misleading naming. Consider also exposing under '/api/equipment-inspections/{id}/signoff' (no /admin/ prefix) for clarity, while keeping the existing path as backward-compat.

OpenItemsPanel + ShopSignoffCard reopen flow (post-DELETE) is timing-sensitive in Playwright — the form testid takes ~2s to remount after the DELETE round-trip. Backend DELETE works (verified directly via pytest). Not a bug, just a UI re-render latency note for future testing agents.
